_source_note: Draft checklist. VERIFY against WHO Guidelines for trauma/injury first-aid and IMNCI/IMCI child injury sections before final use. Not a diagnostic tool.

age.description: Age of the injured person (child vs adult changes urgency)

height_of_fall.description: What they fell from (ground level, stairs, tree, roof, ladder) - height is a key severity marker

loss_of_consciousness.description: Whether the person lost consciousness, even briefly, after the fall

can_move_limbs.description: Whether the person can move all limbs / bear weight (possible fracture check)

visible_deformity_or_bleeding.description: Any visible bone deformity, open wound, or heavy bleeding at the injury site

head_neck_back_involved.description: Whether the head, neck, or back was hit or is painful (spinal injury risk)

pain_level_and_location.description: Where it hurts and how severe

vomiting_after_fall.description: Vomiting after a head injury is a red-flag sign

time_since_fall.description: How long ago the fall happened
